analysis: This PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The visible diff adds documentation: out-of-order observation handling in EnginePerformanceMeasurements.Rate (head 632-638), a DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES=0 rollback switch and decode per-step estimator description (head 882-918), and a trailing line change at head 1780 (base 1736). I examined the base excerpt (lines 1622-1777) and the head excerpt (lines 1-415). The head excerpt does not include the changed ranges 632-638, 882-918 or 1780, so those are covered only via the patch excerpt, which is truncated. Nothing in the visible text changes a security control, trust boundary, key handling, attestation, cache storage (T-041), or authorization. The claims that the new text describes (freshness anchored to the newest observation, heartbeat snapshots not renewing evidence, per-step decode pricing) are performance and admission behavior. They could affect availability or capacity claims in principle, but the evidence cannot establish that without the source code, which is outside this docs-only change. The documentation states that physical admission and deadline checks still apply. No code changes were supplied, so I cannot verify that the described behavior matches the implementation. The rollback env var is documented as a debug/rollback knob rather than a security control. Remaining question: the rest of the truncated patch (after line ~918) was not visible, and any security-relevant claims there were not reviewed.
